AnimationLibrary.remove_curve_meta_data:
X.remove_curve_meta_data(skeleton, curve_name) -> bool
Removes a curve metadata entry for the specified name.

Args:
    skeleton (Skeleton):

AnimationLibrary.rename_curve_meta_data:
X.rename_curve_meta_data(skeleton, old_name, new_name) -> bool
Renames a curve metadata entry. Metadata is preserved, but assigned to a different curve name.

Args:
    skeleton (Skeleton): 
    old_name (Name): The name of an existing curve entry
    new_name (Name): The name to change the entry to

Returns:
    bool: true if the rename was successful (the old name was found and the new name didnt collide with an existing entry)
